title: Grade 6 Math — Fri, Jun 13
description: Basic Geometry — Day 5 of 5: Mixed — lines and angles synthesis
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. The alternate interior angles are ___.
questions.explanation: When a transversal cuts parallel lines, alternate interior angles are equal.

questions.question: Co-interior angles (same-side interior angles) formed by a transversal across parallel lines sum to ___.
questions.explanation: Co-interior (also called consecutive interior) angles are supplementary — they add to 180°.

questions.question: Corresponding angles (formed when a transversal cuts parallel lines) are ___.
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are in the same position at each intersection — they are equal.

questions.question: Find the missing angle: Two parallel lines cut by a transversal. One co-interior angle is 65°. The other is ___.
Angles around a point total 360°. If 4 equal angles meet at a point, each is ___.
Which of these is a pair of parallel lines?
questions.explanation: Opposite sides of a rectangle are parallel to each other.

questions.question: Lines AB and CD are perpendicular. The angle between them is ___.
A triangle has one 90° angle and one 55° angle. The third angle is ___.
Two lines cross. One angle is 70°. What are the other three angles (vertically opposite + supplementary)?
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite = 70°. Adjacent supplementary = 180°−70° = 110°. Two of them. So: 70°, 110°, 110°.

questions.question: How many degrees does the minute hand of a clock turn in 30 minutes?
questions.explanation: The minute hand completes 360° in 60 minutes. In 30 minutes it turns 180° (a straight angle).

questions.question: If one angle of a pair of supplementary angles is twice the other, the angles are ___.
If one angle of a pair of complementary angles is three times the other, the angles are ___.
The exterior angle of a triangle equals ___.
options: The sum of the adjacent interior angles
The sum of the two non-adjacent interior angles
180° minus the interior angle next to it
questions.explanation: The exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two remote (non-adjacent) interior angles.

questions.question: A triangle has interior angles 50° and 70°. Its exterior angle at the third vertex is ___.
Which statement is always true?
options: All triangles have at least one obtuse angle
questions.explanation: All right angles are always exactly 90°. The other statements are false.
